method.build: dist production build served with vite preview

fatalChecks.observed: The production build opened to the title screen, PLAY entered the game, and the playable canvas rendered.
At 390x844 the game canvas occupied 390x844 with no body overflow, clipping, or covered core play area.
Playwright emitted a touch pointerdown/pointerup and a held pointer drag; the ice visibly melted into a continuous path along the drag.
The game continued animating after interaction with responsive input and zero console or page errors.
All observed production-build requests succeeded with no failed requests or HTTP 4xx/5xx responses.
The reviewed locked worktree is clean and smoke-result.json records the matching sourceHash 86ea5ce1efb48b0ff7f030eb184b6e094218b28debcce8b1f2b71908ad119dfd.

notes: The 90-second round was not played to completion; completion and restart are nonblocking for this fatal-only review.

summary.en: The 390x844 production build booted, melted ice in response to real pointer input, and showed no fatal portrait, runtime, asset, or build-identity defect.
